android.notes:
Filming yourself: the camera now opens on the lens you used last, so recording no longer starts by switching to the front camera every single time.

Saving: clips and frame captures can go straight to your Photos library now, as well as into a project.

Loop cues: hold either loop handle to play the loop from its start, and dragging a handle now moves the video with it, so you can see the exact frame you are setting.

Notes: the notes panel is resizable - drag its edge to give a note more room, or hand the space back to the video.

YouTube: a photo view that clears the screen so you can take your own still of a YouTube clip, or of a comparison against one.

Plus a pass over the phone interface - steadier app-bar actions, a tidier tool palette and opening screen - and assorted fixes.
